video-creation/assets/music/accomplishme.notes: Catalog: 305 s, mean -13.1 dBFS, opening build, ending fade; measured -12.1 LUFS / LRA 5.4. Segments: intro low 0-16, build mid 16-28, peak 28-240 (steady 7 with 8 bumps), mid 240-274, peak 274-298, outro 298-305. Programmatic scan of every 98 s window in its env: the flattest starts at 36 s (range 7-8, std 0.44, mean 7.26) -> the CH2 bed uses file 36.0-134.3, no loop. open_questions: Bed B honors Mike's roles_pinned explainer_bed on accomplishments-subtle even though the catalog measures it at aggression 92 (high transient density, contradicting the 'subtle' tag). It is placed 18 dB under (20 under the C1 beat). If it pokes through on the 10 s chunk QA, the measured-subtle swaps are theta-rest (aggression 28, flattest window at file 90-188, G major, calm/reflective) or mighty-hand (aggression 31, window 124-222, D minor, hopeful/suspenseful, closer to the dark-epic key world of Beds A and C). Same span, same level, no loop for either.

Bed C is right-aligned by HIT ONSET (file 117.1 -> 202.10), not by file end; the ring-out under the last 0.7 s and the 0.25 s end fade are deliberate. Mike's AS-RECORDED target says 'later.' ends 202.56: if he wants the hit on the word END rather than its onset, source_in becomes 52.54 (shift +0.46) and the ring-out gets 0.26 s before black.
